text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Assist"—"To give aid or help." That's 
pretty straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
C... "Compound"...? Tch... There really 
was an English word like that...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, getting failing grades and having to 
take supplementary lessons is a total 
drag, after all!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get a perfect score and pump all 
my spare time into training, baby!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh! I can't wait to see the stupid look 
on the teacher's face when they're 
surprised, I tell ya!!
